# 16x Prompt

> 16x Prompt is an AI coding assistant with advanced context management, supporting ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, and other LLMs for software development.

Created by Zhu Liang, 16x Prompt helps developers compose effective prompts by combining task instructions with source code context. It supports multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and Fireworks, with features for Python, Next.js, and general software development workflows.
